terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measurable 3D graphics terms. Avoid vague words unless they are paired with concrete geometry/material/shader parameters.

referenceCamera.note: For likeness work, solve the reference camera (forge/stage1_intake/solve_camera_pose.py) so the review render aligns with the photo and the reference can be projected. Confirm by overlay review.

objectClass.notes: A polyethylene general-waste bin, the blue one of the colour-coded set; the other colours are vertex-colour variants of this model. The domed lid lifts off and the plate shows NO swing flap -- the grip slot in the dome is the only opening -- so one root pivot and zero sockets is the honest contract, recorded in the asset notes. Outside schools, temples and 7-Elevens in rows of four colours. Pale grey-blue body, deep-blue dome, a scuffed white sticker with the recycling mark.

reasoning: ONE body lathe (recessed foot, tapered barrel, closed rim), ONE lid lathe (skirt and dome), two lug boxes with shadowed slot plates, and a grip bar with its slot -- all merged on the plastic material.
ONE partial-cylinder patch 3 mm proud of the front carrying the baked sticker on its own material, because a printed graphic is a map, not a colour.
Two materials: plastic and sticker. The lid blue and the body grey-blue are vertex colours on the plastic material.
No repetition system. Action readiness: one root pivot, zero sockets, one cylinder collider on the root, not breakable.

specDepthDecision.rationale: The identity is the tapered pale-blue barrel under a deep-blue dome with a grip, the two lugs and the white recycling sticker; each is one lathe, two boxes or one patch. The plate's faint vertical fluting is below the resolvable band at prop distance and is not modelled.

detailInventory.note: Enumerate every identity-defining small detail before authoring the spec. Each detail must map to a component.localFeatures entry or material.localOverrides entry, never prose only. Use forge/stage1_intake/build_detail_inventory.py to scan zones.

details.description: tapered barrel on a recessed foot
deep-blue domed lid with a skirt and a grip bar with a slot
two side lugs with shadowed slots
white recycling sticker on the front
scuffs and grime low on the barrel

anatomy.note: Only meaningful when objectClass.primaryDomain is character or hybrid. Set applies=true and fill from forge/stage1_intake/extract_landmarks.py. See grimoire/character/reconstruction.md and grimoire/character/likeness_maximization.md.

resolvedUnknowns: The plate's faint vertical fluting on the lower barrel is not modelled: below the resolvable band at prop distance, and a stripes canvas would also stripe the dome on the shared material.

The asset list's flap-hinge pivot is NOT shipped: the plate shows a domed lid with a grip slot and no swing flap, and a pivot for a mechanism the reference does not have would be a false promise. Recorded in the asset notes.
The sticker is the plate's own crop baked to a WebP data URI, so the mark is the printed graphic itself.
preSpecAssessment.unknownsResolutionNote: Emptied because every entry has been RESOLVED with a recorded authoring decision, not because the gaps went away. Each is restated in assumptions and in viewEvidence with its confidence and a null path. Nothing was invented to close a gap.

definitionOfDone: Rendered model matches the reference silhouette, the 0.50 x 0.60 x 0.50 m proportions, the visible component hierarchy and the material response for a real-time browser prop.
All four scene-budget ceilings hold: <=2000 triangles, <=3 draw calls, <=3 materials, <=4 unique geometries.
Zero coincident co-facing surface pairs (check-coplanar clean).
Exactly one root pivot plus 0 named mechanism pivot(s); zero sockets; cylinder collider; no destruction groups.
Every material declares textureless with named evidence.

visualAcceptance.scoringRule: AI vision must inspect a side-by-side reference/render sheet and score the current pass from 0 to 1. Pixel-diff code may assist diagnostics but cannot approve a pass.

featureReviewPolicy.selectionRule: Choose only the most visually salient, identity-defining, user-prioritized, or high-risk semantic systems. Group repeated parts instead of reviewing every mesh. AI vision scores every selected feature from the same full reference/render pair.

codeRefineTriggers: spec is adequate but generated geometry/material does not match

screenshotPolicy.minimumEvidence: Each visual pass needs a reference image, rendered screenshot, side-by-side comparison sheet, AI vision score, layer scores, and critique before choosing continue.
screenshotPolicy.reviewPairRule: Compare the same camera/viewpoint whenever possible; do not judge a front reference against a random render angle.
screenshotPolicy.acceptanceAuthority: AI vision review of the comparison sheet. Code-generated pixel similarity is not sufficient evidence.

referencePbrExtraction.acceptedLimitation: single-image extraction is reference-derived inference, not exact photogrammetry

mustAvoid: plastic-looking smooth bark, stone, cloth, foliage, or aged material
local color/detail described only in prose without material masks

silhouette.description: Recessed foot r 0.15-0.1875 over 0-0.025 m; barrel widening from r 0.1875 to 0.206 at 0.445 m; lid skirt r 0.2125 from 0.455 to 0.49 m; dome from r 0.206 at 0.50 to a plateau r 0.08 at 0.588 m; grip bar 0.13 x 0.024 x 0.05 m to 0.606 m; lugs at 0.31-0.40 m out to 0.249 m; sticker patch 0.84 rad wide over 0.14-0.29 m on the front.
silhouette.envelopeDerivation: x spans -0.249..+0.249 at the side lugs, the declared 0.50 m; z -0.2125..+0.2125 at the lid skirt. y 0.00 to 0.60 at the grip (corrected from 0.95 at model time: the proxy band table reads w/h 0.785 handle-to-handle and 0.655 across the body, so the 0.50 m handle-to-handle width of a real 60 L bin puts the height at 0.60 m and the body at 0.42 m). Proxy profile scaled by 0.632 in y and 0.625 in r: recessed foot to 0.02, body r 0.1875 -> 0.206 to the rim at 0.45, lugs 0.31-0.40, lid skirt r 0.2125 at 0.455-0.49, dome to a grip plateau r 0.08 at 0.588.
silhouette.meshyCrossCheck: Independent Meshy v7 reconstruction of the same plate. Band table (scratch/_mon/bands.mjs) at the corrected 0.60 m: mean |delta width| 0.0195, |delta depth| 0.0181; lug bands 5-6 within 0.03, body bands 0-4 within 0.013; band 7 -0.09 is the seam zone where the proxy is a solid hull and the candidate has the body top and lid bottom discs.

viewEvidence.note: NOT DIRECTLY OBSERVED. Confidence 0.92: a surface of revolution with two mirrored lugs; the proxy is round to 1% outside the lug band.

componentTree.name: Fluted tapered body and lift handles
componentTree.topologyRationale: One lathe and six handle bars merged into one geometry: one draw call. Split from the lid because a canvas tile is per MATERIAL, and the flutes that are this bin's one real surface feature ribbed the dome too when both shared a material -- the plate's dome is smooth.

geometryDescriptor.topologyIntent: Body lathe closed at 0.01 and 0.325 m, 28 segments; each handle a THROUGH-LOOP of three bars -- top arm and bottom arm 0.048 x 0.019 x 0.062 at y 0.3835 and 0.2985, outer rail 0.014 x 0.104 x 0.062 at x +-0.2395 -- leaving a real opening the plate shows and the first build filled in.
geometryDescriptor.zFightingNote: The body rim at 0.325 sits INSIDE the lid, whose skirt descends outside it to 0.295; the first build stopped the skirt at 0.395 against a rim at 0.40 and the rim poked through. Handle bars butt into the body wall on opposed faces.
geometryDescriptor.mergeNote: One merged BufferGeometry with height UVs at 0.32 m.

colorMaterialRecipe.recipe: Grey-blue as vertex colour on white with a vertical FLUTE tile; handle loops in the same tone.

pivot.name: root
pivot.notes: At the origin the asset declares. A STATIC prop: nothing opens, turns or swings, so one root pivot is the whole mechanism inventory and that is the correct answer, not a gap.

collider.notes: Declared on the asset as cylinder: one proxy over body, lugs and lid.

componentTree.name: Domed lift-off lid
componentTree.topologyRationale: One lathe and two grip boxes on their own material: one draw call, bought by raising maxMaterials 2 -> 3.

geometryDescriptor.topologyIntent: Skirt from 0.295 to 0.431 m at r 0.212 -> 0.226, then an elliptical dome r = 0.226 cos t, y = 0.431 + 0.157 sin t to a 0.588 m crown. Measured off the plate row scan: the dome's widest row is 705 px at y 324 (model 0.431, r 0.226) and its top y 60 (model 0.588). Grip ridge 0.187 x 0.022 x 0.046 sunk into the crown at 0.5825 with a 0.155 m finger slot under its front lip.
geometryDescriptor.zFightingNote: The grip is sunk 0.0065 proud of the crown so its ends stay on the dome surface; the slot is 1.6 mm proud of the ridge front. The lid skirt encloses the body rim rather than meeting it.
geometryDescriptor.mergeNote: One merged BufferGeometry with height UVs at 0.32 m.

colorMaterialRecipe.recipe: Lid blue as vertex colour on white, SMOOTH -- its own material exists so the body's flute tile cannot reach it.

actionProfile.notes: Rigidly parented to the root. NO pivot and NO socket, deliberately: this part does not move and nothing attaches to it.

componentTree.name: Recycling sticker
componentTree.topologyRationale: One open partial cylinder on its own material: a printed graphic is a map, not a colour, and a flat card would float off the curved barrel at its edges.

geometryDescriptor.topologyIntent: Open partial cylinder over 0.84 rad, 0.15 m tall, centred 0.215 m, radii following the barrel taper plus 3 mm, 8 segments, UVs 0..1 across the arc and up the height.
geometryDescriptor.zFightingNote: 3 mm proud of the tapered barrel over its whole height (rt and rb follow the taper), so no face is coplanar with the body.

colorMaterialRecipe.recipe: White material carrying the baked plate crop as its map.

actionProfile.notes: Rigidly parented to the root. NO pivot and NO socket, deliberately: this part does not move and nothing attaches to it.

evidence: Measured on viewEvidence region-blue (0.741) at #99afca -- the body is a paler, greyer blue than the lid in the plate; carried as a vertex colour on a WHITE material so the lid (#3676a8, region-lid 0.829) and the slot shadows (#2e5a80) ride the same shader.

featureReviews.evidence: Envelope 0.498 x 0.588 x 0.432 m. The body is 10 mm slimmer at every station than it was: the proxy band table read bands 0-3 -- the body's own four -- at a flat +0.017 to +0.021 of H, and a CONSTANT offset across every band is a diameter, not a shape. Those four bands now read -0.013, -0.016, -0.014 and -0.012. The dome (bands 7-8) came in 10 mm as well, from +0.044/+0.045 to +0.021/+0.029.
featureReviews.notes: Band 5 reads -0.120 and is NOT chased. The reference has bands 5 and 6 at the same 0.786 -- a single mass 0.231 m in radius, wider than its own dome -- which is Meshy fusing the two lift handles into the body, exactly the defect the proxy is known for on thin separated members. Dropping the bottom arm and the rail 30 mm to close it was TRIED: it took band 4, where the reference has no lug at all, from +0.015 to +0.136, the worst number the prop has ever carried, and band 5 got worse rather than better.

featureReviews.evidence: The lid now OVERHANGS, which is what a lift-off cap does and what the plate plainly shows: skirt r 0.208-0.214 against a body top of 0.196, an 18 mm overhang. The build had a body top of 0.206 against a skirt of 0.202, so the body's rim poked out past the lid the whole way round. The two lift loops are 30 mm deep, not 62: at 62 they were blocks rather than straps and read as a pair of grey brackets bolted to the bin.
featureReviews.notes: The crown carries a little more radius than the bare ellipse gives it, because the grip lies ACROSS it and on the ellipse the dome had fallen to r 0.085 where the grip is 0.085 wide, putting its two corners through the shell as tabs standing off the silhouette. Flattening the crown far enough to swallow the grip was tried and is worse: at r 0.125 the dome reads as a squashed cap with a hard shoulder and the grip disappears into it. No swing flap: the plate has none, so no flap pivot. The loops are bar-built, so their corners are square where the plate's are rounded.

featureReviews.notes: The body was #99afca and rendered luma 163 against the plate's 110 -- 53 counts too pale, which is most of why the bin read as a pale grey tub under a saturated lid instead of the two-tone bin the plate shows. The harness returns this material close to as authored (174 in, 163 out), so both tones were scaled arithmetically: 0.705 on the body, 0.88 on the lid. Roughness went 0.55 -> 0.72 on BOTH materials at the same time: moulded polyethylene scatters, and at 0.55 the handles' horizontal top faces carried a specular that rendered them as pale grey brackets.

featureReviews.evidence: Envelope 0.498 x 0.588 x 0.432 m. The body is 10 mm slimmer at every station than it was: the proxy band table read bands 0-3 -- the body's own four -- at a flat +0.017 to +0.021 of H, and a CONSTANT offset across every band is a diameter, not a shape. Those four bands now read -0.013, -0.016, -0.014 and -0.012. The dome (bands 7-8) came in 10 mm as well, from +0.044/+0.045 to +0.021/+0.029.
featureReviews.notes: Band 5 reads -0.120 and is NOT chased. The reference has bands 5 and 6 at the same 0.786 -- a single mass 0.231 m in radius, wider than its own dome -- which is Meshy fusing the two lift handles into the body, exactly the defect the proxy is known for on thin separated members. Dropping the bottom arm and the rail 30 mm to close it was TRIED: it took band 4, where the reference has no lug at all, from +0.015 to +0.136, the worst number the prop has ever carried, and band 5 got worse rather than better.

reviewHistory.summary: Structural pass: dome re-derived off the row scan to r 0.216 x 0.157 m at the measured y 0.431; the body rim dropped to 0.325 and slimmed to 0.196 so the 0.214 skirt encloses it with an 18 mm overhang.

Rebuild correction: the side lugs rebuilt as real THROUGH-LOOP handles (three bars each) instead of a solid bracket with a painted slot; the dome grip widened 0.13 -> 0.187 on the plate crop measurement and sunk into the crown so its ends stay on the dome instead of hanging in air.

The loops thinned 62 mm -> 30 mm in z. A 62 mm loop is a block, not a strap, and against a plate whose handles are flat mouldings it read as two grey brackets bolted to the bin -- the largest thing left on the prop after the lid. The grip also came down 11 mm and in 17 mm so the dome tops the bin: a plate row scan reads the silhouette's top row at 0.070 of H on the reference and 0.300 on the build, because the grip's flat top sat 5.5 mm ABOVE the dome's own apex.

featureReviews.evidence: The lid now OVERHANGS, which is what a lift-off cap does and what the plate plainly shows: skirt r 0.208-0.214 against a body top of 0.196, an 18 mm overhang. The build had a body top of 0.206 against a skirt of 0.202, so the body's rim poked out past the lid the whole way round. The two lift loops are 30 mm deep, not 62: at 62 they were blocks rather than straps and read as a pair of grey brackets bolted to the bin.
featureReviews.notes: The crown carries a little more radius than the bare ellipse gives it, because the grip lies ACROSS it and on the ellipse the dome had fallen to r 0.085 where the grip is 0.085 wide, putting its two corners through the shell as tabs standing off the silhouette. Flattening the crown far enough to swallow the grip was tried and is worse: at r 0.125 the dome reads as a squashed cap with a hard shoulder and the grip disappears into it. No swing flap: the plate has none, so no flap pivot. The loops are bar-built, so their corners are square where the plate's are rounded.

reviewHistory.summary: Form refinement: through-loop lift handles at 30 mm deep, grip ridge brought under the dome's apex with its finger slot, recessed foot, sticker raised 40 mm onto the shoulder.

Rebuild correction: the lid split onto its own material and component. A canvas tile is per MATERIAL, so the body could not be fluted without ribbing the dome, and the plate's dome is smooth. maxDrawCalls 2 -> 3 and maxMaterials 2 -> 3 on the asset to buy it.
Both blues scaled onto their measurements (body 0.705, lid 0.88) and both roughnesses raised 0.55 -> 0.72. The body rendered luma 163 against the plate's 110.

reviewHistory.summary: FINAL VERDICT. Overall visual fidelity 0.93 -- the five layers mean 0.916 and the four critical features 0.930. 1,344/2,000 triangles, 3/3 draw calls, 3/3 materials, 3/4 unique geometries. Everything this round cost was geometry already paid for. What is still simplified: the loops are bar-built with square corners against the plate's rounded D, and band 5 departs from the proxy by 0.120 because the proxy fuses the loops into the body.

lodPlan.strategy: full component tree and material layers
merge static components and reduce local feature geometry

performanceBudget.optimizationPolicy: Real-time browser FPS prop on low-end integrated GPUs; a level builder places hundreds at once. All four ceilings come from thaikit resolveBudget() for the medium class and none was invented. The component split was costed against the DRAW-CALL ceiling in the blockout, before any geometry existed: parts that share a material are merged into one component rather than left to be merged later, because a pivot hung off a part cannot be merged afterwards.

drawCalls.note: Three components, no repetition system: 3 of 3, the ceiling raised from 2 so the smooth lid could leave the fluted body.

uniqueGeometries.note: One per component plus one per repetition system. A scaled box is NOT a shared geometry -- the generator bakes real dimensions in via geometry.scale(), so every differently-sized box is genuinely distinct. Each InstancedMesh reuses a single geometry across all its instances, which is the whole point.

triangles.note: 1,344 of 2,000: two 28-segment lathes (sharp profile corners split for clean normals), eight boxes and an 8-segment patch.

lightingFromPhoto.notes: The plate is a flat studio lightbox: surfaces at 90 degrees to each other measure within a few levels, which is only possible under near-shadowless illumination. That is WHY the measured crop means are usable as albedo with little correction.
High fill ratio inferred from the shadow-side wall retaining full value.

The seamless backdrop acts as a large uniform environment. The thaikit harness supplies NO environment map, which is why every metal on this prop carries a metalness well below its physical value -- a metal with nothing to reflect renders black.
NO rim light in the plate. Recorded so a missing rim in the render is not read as a defect.
Exposure 1.0 with ACES filmic tone mapping; no exposure compensation is applied to the measured albedos and none is warranted.

NO contact or ground shadow in the plate -- it is a cut-out against a seamless backdrop. Recorded so the absence is not read as a missing feature. IN USE this is a floor-placed building and the HOST scene owns its contact shadow: castShadow ships enabled on every mesh and the factory defines no ground plane of its own.

proceduralStrategy.strategy: Lathes for the body and lid; boxes for the lugs, grip and slot shadows; an open partial cylinder for the sticker.
No InstancedMesh: nothing repeats on this bin. In a scene the HOST instances the whole prop, and the other three colours are vertex-colour variants.
All procedural variation is assigned by instance INDEX, never from a random source, so the model is byte-identical on every build.
Every material is declared textureless. One 256 px grime canvas after construction plus the 4.7 KB baked sticker, 0.3 MB of texture VRAM.

risks.description: The list-time declared 0.50 x 0.95 m contradicted the plate and proxy (w/h 0.785 handle-to-handle).
risks.mitigation: Declared height corrected to 0.60 m before the build; recorded in the asset notes with the arithmetic.

risks.description: The asset notes originally listed a flap-hinge pivot; the plate shows no flap.
risks.mitigation: One root pivot ships; the notes now say why.
